items.name: Time-Pause Watch
items.description: A home-made wrist gadget held together with duct tape and spare wires. Pauses time.

items.name: Berries
items.description: A handful of wild berries. Geese can't resist them.

items.name: Corn
items.description: A cob of corn. Geese go mad for it.

items.name: Red Goose
items.description: Energy drink. Tastes like a battery and regret.

items.name: Ramen
items.description: A steaming bowl of instant noodles. Student staple.

items.name: Crisps
items.description: A crumpled packet of ready salted crisps.

items.name: Bus Ticket
items.description: A crumpled single to campus. Don't lose it.

items.name: Grass Repellent Spray
items.description: Keeps the grass (and whatever lives in it) away.

items.name: Force Field Shield
items.description: An old knight's shield bearing the University's arms, found in Heslington Hall. Raises a force field around you.

items.name: Rubber Duck
items.description: Squeaks. The real ducks find it deeply suspicious.

items.name: Umbrella
items.description: Keeps the rain off. Essential kit in York.
